content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-working-3|Get Digital]] creators in regions like Nigeria and Kenya often struggle with payment processing platforms such as Stripe and PayPal, which are either unavailable or slow to respond. This guide addresses that challenge by walking you through setting up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-15|nowpayments]] digital store, allowing you to receive crypto payments directly and efficiently. With the right infrastructure, you can process transactions immediately and maintain full ownership of your sales data.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to options]] are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, ensure you have essential tools in place. Start with a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website. You will also need a backend solution, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to handle payment processing logic. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments documentation to integrate it seamlessly into your site. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a robust payment and delivery pipeline, begin by configuring your NOWPayments account for automatic payment verification. Integrate it with your website using the provided API keys. Next, set up a storage solution, like Supabase or Google Sheets, to manage orders efficiently. Ensure that your files are securely stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for quick delivery upon receipt of payment. This structure maximizes efficiency and ensures customer satisfaction.
NOWPayments allows for instant crypto transactions without KYC requirements.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, conduct a live test of your store. Start by listing a digital product, and then simulate a transaction using your NOWPayments integration. Make sure to track the transaction from payment initiation to product delivery to confirm that everything functions as expected. Monitor the speed of USDT payments on networks like Tron and Solana to ensure a swift customer experience. After a successful test, you can officially launch your store to the public.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, focus on scaling your operations. Use analytics from your sales data to understand customer preferences and optimize your offerings. Introduce more products as you grow, ensuring your backend can handle increased traffic and transactions. Leverage your NOWPayments integration to expand payment options and explore additional marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. Continuous improvement and iteration will keep your store competitive and thriving.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
You retain complete ownership of your sales data post-deployment.

For a deeper understanding of setting up your NOWPayments digital store, explore related guides such as 'nowpayments digital products webhook setup guide' and consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all the blueprints and templates you need. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

You can receive crypto payments by integrating NOWPayments with your digital store. Follow the integration guide to connect your store to the NOWPayments API, enabling acceptance of various cryptocurrencies.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on networks like Tron are confirmed almost instantly, typically within a few minutes. In contrast, PayPal transactions can take longer due to processing and banking delays.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to Naira?

Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to Naira through peer-to-peer platforms like Binance or Patricia. These services facilitate direct exchanges, allowing users to convert cryptocurrencies without relying on traditional banks.
What transaction fees should I expect with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of only 0.5% per transaction across more than 300 cryptocurrencies. This fee structure allows you to maximize your earnings without excessive costs.
Is there any limit on the number of products I can sell?
There is no inherent limit on the number of products you can sell using your NOWPayments digital store. As your business grows, you can continuously add more digital products to your inventory.
Hosting on platforms like GitHub Pages can be entirely free.
